verdict.rationale: Spline is a design tool, so exporting production assets is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents web and runtime exports: a spline-viewer embed, code exports (Vanilla JS, Three.js, React and others) and a self-hosted ZIP. Nothing in the pack mentions PNG, SVG or PDF asset export, per-layer export presets, scale multipliers or slices.

support.subject: As a designer, I can export production assets — PNG, SVG, PDF, and more — with per-layer presets, scales, and slices
